pending.finding: All six normalized runs show a fresh merge_pending readback owned by GitHub with no request. Three fail correctness solely because missing_entry_read was recorded. No pending run records a wrong route, guessed owner command, provider request, or authority ambiguity.

identity.finding: Five normalized runs show refusal of pr.head.repository and return to supervisor without a request; run-12 has no owner event. Five runs record missing_entry_read, and run-12 additionally records missing_identity_refusal and missing_owner_observation. No identity run records a decision-barrier violation.

recovery.finding: All six normalized runs first refuse missing merge_commit. Only run-11 then reaches close_pending without a request, but that run subsequently emits a provider request and records a guessed owner command. The other five runs record missing_recovery_continuation. Four recovery runs also record missing_entry_read.

overall_decision_barrier.finding: Wrong-route and authority-ambiguity counts are zero in every run. Run-11 alone violates the frozen barrier through one guessed owner command and a provider_request_emitted observer error.

observer_control_findings.finding: The frozen control mappings are coherent for all three cases: legal observations map to no errors; false resolution maps to false_resolution; string owner and authority ambiguity map to authority_ambiguity; and omitted-owner probes map to case-specific missing-observation errors. Normalized run errors are consistent with those mappings, with guessed_owner_command and provider_request_emitted separately counted as decision-barrier failures.
observer_control_findings.scope: Validity is limited to the recorded normalized packet and its declared mappings; the packet does not provide a complete native trace of control injection and execution.

static_check_findings.finding: The recorded static check is internally consistent with a treatment-bound textual entry change and unchanged executable owner source. It is not evidence that the behavioral criteria passed and it does not authorize landing.

limitations: The packet contains recorded subprocess evidence rather than a complete native trace.
Arm assignment was withheld, so no treatment assignment, arm comparison, causal estimate, or retention decision is made or inferred.
The audit was restricted to the normalized fields in blind-packet.json; raw evidence, selection material, instructions, run directories, prior trials, and the GitHub Issue were not inspected.
Bytes, command count, searches, and elapsed time were treated only as telemetry and did not affect correctness.
Observer-control validity and static-check validity are conclusions about the frozen packet's recorded declarations and normalized evidence, not independent re-execution.
